mapper.select:
SELECT draft_id AS draftId, branch_code AS branchCode, status AS status, po_id AS poId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM place_order_draft WHERE branch_code = #{_parameter} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' LIMIT 1

SELECT dd.draft_detail_id AS draftDetailId, dd.draft_id AS draftId, dd.material_code AS materialCode, dd.requested_qty AS requestedQty, dd.source_type AS sourceType,
m.material_name AS materialName, mg.group_name AS categoryName, m.unit AS unit, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(bs.current_qty), 0) AS SIGNED) AS currentStock, CAST(COALESCE(bmss.safe_stock_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) AS safeStock
FROM place_order_draft_detail dd JOIN material m ON dd.material_code = m.material_code JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id LEFT JOIN branch_stock bs ON bs.branch_code = (SELECT branch_code FROM place_order_draft WHERE draft_id = dd.draft_id) AND bs.material_code = dd.material_code LEFT JOIN branch_material_safety_stock bmss ON bmss.branch_code = (SELECT branch_code FROM place_order_draft WHERE draft_id = dd.draft_id) AND bmss.material_code = dd.material_code
WHERE dd.draft_id = #{_parameter}
GROUP BY dd.draft_detail_id, dd.draft_id, dd.material_code, dd.requested_qty, dd.source_type, m.material_name, mg.group_name, m.unit, bmss.safe_stock_qty

SELECT m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, mg.group_name AS categoryName, m.unit AS unit,
CAST(COALESCE(SUM(bs.current_qty), 0) AS SIGNED) AS currentStock, CAST(bmss.safe_stock_qty AS SIGNED) AS safeStock,
0 AS requestedQty
FROM material m
JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id
JOIN branch_material_safety_stock bmss ON m.material_code = bmss.material_code AND bmss.branch_code = #{_parameter}
LEFT JOIN branch_stock bs ON bs.branch_code = #{_parameter} AND bs.material_code = m.material_code
GROUP BY m.material_code, m.material_name, mg.group_name, m.unit, bmss.safe_stock_qty
HAVING currentStock < safeStock
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_order_draft_detail ( draft_id, material_code, requested_qty, source_type ) VALUES ( #{draftId}, #{materialCode}, #{requestedQty}, #{sourceType} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE requested_qty = VALUES(requested_qty), source_type = VALUES(source_type)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT mg.material_group_id AS materialGroupId, mg.group_name AS groupName FROM material m JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id ORDER BY mg.group_name

SELECT m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, mg.group_name AS categoryName, m.unit AS unit, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(bs.current_qty), 0) AS SIGNED) AS currentStock, CAST(COALESCE(bmss.safe_stock_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) AS safeStock, CAST(COALESCE(mol.min_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) AS minQty, CAST(COALESCE(mol.max_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) AS maxQty, CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(SUM(bs.current_qty), 0) AS SIGNED) < CAST(COALESCE(bmss.safe_stock_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isLowStock, CASE WHEN dd.draft_detail_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isAdded, dd.source_type AS sourceType FROM material m JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id LEFT JOIN branch_stock bs ON bs.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bs.material_code = m.material_code LEFT JOIN branch_material_safety_stock bmss ON bmss.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bmss.material_code = m.material_code LEFT JOIN material_order_limit mol ON mol.material_code = m.material_code LEFT JOIN place_order_draft_detail dd ON dd.draft_id = #{draftId} AND dd.material_code = m.material_code GROUP BY m.material_code, m.material_name, mg.group_name, m.unit, bmss.safe_stock_qty, dd.draft_detail_id, dd.source_type ORDER BY isAdded DESC, isLowStock DESC, mg.group_name ASC, m.material_name ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT m.material_code FROM material m JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id JOIN branch_material_safety_stock bmss ON m.material_code = bmss.material_code AND bmss.branch_code = #{branchCode} LEFT JOIN branch_stock bs ON bs.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bs.material_code = m.material_code GROUP BY m.material_code, bmss.safe_stock_qty HAVING COALESCE(SUM(bs.current_qty), 0) < bmss.safe_stock_qty ) AS low_stock_sub
